program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (filter (lambda (o) (and (filled? o) (>= (obj-size o) 4)))
                                (objects g 0)))
                  (centers (map (lambda (o)
                                  (let ((bb (obj-bbox o)))
                                    (list (obj-color o)
                                          (quotient (+ (first bb) (third bb)) 2)
                                          (quotient (+ (second bb) (fourth bb)) 2))))
                                objs)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let* ((hits (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (col) col)
                                                              (map (lambda (cn)
                                                                     (cond
                                                                       ((or
                                                                          (= (second cn)
                                                                             r)
                                                                          (= (list-ref cn
                                                                                       2)
                                                                             c)) (first cn))
                                                                       (else #f)))
                                                                   centers)))))
                        (cond
                          ((> (length hits) 1) 0)
                          ((= (length hits) 1) (first hits))
                          (else v))))))))
